name: Azure Entra ID - Successful Sign-In Events
title: Azure Entra ID - Successful Sign-In Events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}
| json "status.failureReason", "status.errorCode", "status.additionalDetails", "createdDateTime", "_logType", "appDisplayName", "conditionalAccessStatus", "clientAppUsed", "ipAddress", "correlationId", "id", "location", "location.countryOrRegion", "location.city", "location.state", "location.geoCoordinates.latitude", "location.geoCoordinates.longitude","deviceDetail.operatingSystem", "deviceDetail.browser","deviceDetail.displayName", "userDisplayName", "userPrincipalName", "riskState" as failureReason, errorCode, failureDetails, date_time, logtype, appDisplayName, conditionalAccessStatus, clientAppUsed, ip_addr, correlationId, id, location, country_or_region, city, state, latitude, longitude, operating_system, browser, deviceDisplayName, userDisplayName, userPrincipalName, riskState nodrop
| if(riskState in ("atRisk", "confirmedCompromised"), "true", "false") as is_risky
| where errorCode = 0 AND city matches "{{city}}" AND appDisplayName matches "{{appDisplayName}}" AND userPrincipalName matches "{{userPrincipalName}}" AND clientAppUsed matches "{{clientAppUsed}}" AND browser matches "{{browser}}" AND logtype matches "{{logtype}}" AND is_Risky matches "{{is_Risky}}" AND ip_addr matches "{{ip_addr}}"
| count as frequency by latitude, longitude, country_or_region, city, state
| sort by frequency
